sources.locator: Quick Start; What Tutti Does; Project Status
sources.finding: Documents Rust/tmux CLI, browser operations view, agent roles and optional direct API spine; direct CLI wiring remains listed as planned.

sources.title: Tutti LICENSE
sources.finding: MIT license for the repository, separate from external coding agents and services.

sources.title: Tutti CHANGELOG.md
sources.finding: Release prose advertises an API-direct spine and local event log; it is not proof that the workflow runner exposes that engine.

sources.title: Tutti docs/AGENT_OPS_ROADMAP.md
sources.finding: Undated roadmap proposes RBAC, approvals, control-plane hardening, governance and future event collection/retention; those plans do not establish current implementation.

sources.title: Tutti src/config/mod.rs
sources.finding: TOML holds roles, agents, worktree preferences, workflow steps, limited dependency edges, schedules, hooks, profiles and optional guards. Agents and workflow runs are distinct from external GitHub issue records.

sources.title: Tutti src/cli/up.rs
sources.finding: Launches separate tmux agents in dependency order, enforces configured profile concurrency and API-profile budget prechecks, injects configured memory into Claude instructions or other runtimes prompts. A filtered launch only warns if dependencies are not running.

sources.title: Tutti src/runtime/mod.rs
sources.finding: Four CLI runtime adapters integrate Claude Code, Codex, Aider and OpenClaw. Status uses terminal patterns and explicit markers where available; this is not measured status accuracy.

sources.title: Tutti src/session/tmux.rs
sources.finding: Detached named tmux sessions own agent processes. Pane capture and pasted input support local attachment and steering; a live session survives the client terminal disconnect on the same host. Only CLAUDECODE is explicitly stripped from inherited environment.

sources.title: Tutti src/automation/mod.rs
sources.locator: WorkflowExecutor::execute lines 797-925; resume preflight; artifact capture
sources.finding: Workflow runner persists step intents/results and can resume with compensation checks. Direct steps are explicitly rejected before execution. Dependency execution supports only ensure_running/review/land control steps; other paths run sequentially. Artifacts and injected files pass results between stages.

sources.title: Tutti src/cli/issue_claim.rs
sources.finding: GitHub comment-backed leases use TTL/heartbeat, server comment ordering and a winner check to reduce duplicate automation claims; external users can still edit issues and comments. This is not a native issue database.

sources.title: Tutti src/cli/serve.rs
sources.finding: HTTP/SSE serves dashboard and status, runs, logs, handoffs, policy records plus up/down/send/run/verify/review/land actions. Localhost is default; non-local binding without bearer authentication is refused. There is no per-user role identity in the route layer.

sources.title: Tutti src/scheduler/mod.rs
sources.finding: Five-field cron schedules run on the serving host, persist last runs and prevent the same in-flight key within this scheduler. The server must remain running; there is no vendor scheduler.

sources.title: Tutti src/webhook.rs
sources.finding: Config matches source/events and expands incoming JSON into prompts; expansion is verbatim untrusted input. A local JSONL record logs event/outcome.

sources.title: Tutti src/worktree/mod.rs
sources.finding: Creates per-agent Git branches/worktrees and can reset a fresh worktree to project HEAD; no OS/container/VM/network isolation is implemented here.

sources.title: Tutti src/state/mod.rs
sources.finding: Local JSON/JSONL state stores agents, health, run ledgers, step intents, checkpoints, events and policy records. Run telemetry is a local append-only JSONL file with no uploader. Active events rotate after 5000 entries, retain2500 and archive older entries without a timed deletion promise.

sources.title: Tutti src/budget/mod.rs
sources.finding: Weekly workspace/agent token guards apply only when the selected profile plan is API. Warn mode continues; enforce blocks subsequent checked operations. This is not universal in-flight billing enforcement.

sources.title: Tutti src/usage/mod.rs
sources.locator: TokenUsage; AggregatedUsage; Claude and Codex parsers
sources.finding: Reads local Claude/Codex token logs, model and session categories. This does not reconcile actual provider charges or all runtime usage.

sources.title: Tutti src/permissions/mod.rs
sources.finding: Configured command allow rules gate workflow commands; absent policy allows. Claude settings receive translated permissions. Different CLI adapters can retain native defaults rather than equal enforcement.

sources.title: Tutti src/agent/policy.rs
sources.finding: API-direct library policy filters tools and best-effort network commands; source explicitly says network filter is not a security boundary and requires_approval is reserved, not implemented. This library is not wired to runnable direct workflow steps.

sources.title: Tutti src/cli/handoff.rs
sources.finding: Writes handoff packets from current state and terminal context; Apply sends packet text to an existing agent. It does not migrate process memory or transfer authenticated human ownership.

sources.title: Tutti src/cli/review.rs
sources.finding: Builds a dated Markdown packet containing branch, merge base, committed/WIP diffs, then prompts a named reviewer. Packet creation alone is not approval bound to candidate HEAD.

sources.title: Tutti src/cli/land.rs
sources.finding: Land commits WIP and either pushes/opens a PR or cherry-picks into current branch. Optional TT_ENFORCE_MERGE_GATE checks GitHub required checks and unresolved review threads; it is off without the flag. No separate human approval or exact-HEAD receipt is created.

sources.title: Tutti src/cli/remote.rs
sources.finding: Creates an SSH local-port-forward and records named remote hosts; it assumes an already configured remote host/server rather than provisioning managed compute.

sources.title: Tutti dashboard/style.css
sources.finding: Browser focus/sidebar/pipeline/ops layouts rearrange at mobile widths. This is source support, not measured usability.
